query:
One group member made a point of requesting that the exact trip dates be confirmed before the end of the week, expressing a need to check their calendar before fully committing. Which member made this specific request?

Options:
A. Priya
B. Dev
C. Simone
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Simone, episodic, t2 @2025-10-12T17:54:00) In, assuming I can confirm by end of week. Just to flag, I'd need the exact dates locked down so I can check my calendar properly. Can we confirm Friday at the latest?
[2] (about=Dev, episodic, t12 @2025-11-16T20:14:00) Checkout.
[3] (about=Jonah, core, t14 @2025-11-23T19:16:00) Supports a city trip in spring if it's a good city, not against it.
[4] (about=Marcus, core, t14 @2025-11-23T19:16:00) Needs to make a New Year booking by Friday at the latest and asks everyone to confirm their plans.
[5] (about=Marcus, core, t6 @2025-10-26T18:01:00) Actually booked the bunkhouse for the hike; confirmation email sent to everyone including Simone.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t14 @2025-11-23T19:16:00) Group decided to discuss a city trip in spring in January, not now.
[7] (about=Priya, core, t4 @2025-10-19T19:15:00) Would probably go on a third date if asked, which she acknowledges tells her something.
[8] (about=Simone, core, t2 @2025-10-12T17:46:00) In for the hike assuming she can confirm by end of week; needs exact dates locked down and asks to confirm by Friday at the latest.
[9] (about=Simone, core, t10 @2025-11-09T19:31:00) Last day at the firm is December 19th; flies to Singapore January 6th.
